title: 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape maps more than 400 companies worldwide
summary: The new edition maps more than 400 companies building robots for food crops, nearly 25% more than in 2024; more than 40% of the U.S. companies are in California.
subhead: New edition includes nearly 25% more companies than in 2024; California is home to more than 40% of the U.S. companies represented

related.label: The 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape (The Mixing Bowl)

title: Media Invited to 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape Launch
summary: Reporters were invited to the September 16 webinar releasing the 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape, with a panel on adoption, validation and the agricultural workforce.
subhead: September 16 webinar will examine adoption barriers and the future of agricultural work

title: California AgTech Alliance launches to help farmers stay competitive
summary: UC ANR, CDFA and GO-Biz launch a $15 million statewide partnership with nine regional innovation hubs and more than 50 partner organizations.
subhead: $15 million statewide collaboration unites state, university and industry leaders to fast-track agricultural innovation, workforce development and regional economic growth

title: California AgTech Alliance to Launch at FIRA USA Oct. 22
summary: Reporters were invited to the Alliance’s launch at FIRA USA in Woodland, with UC ANR’s Gabriel Youtsey and CDFA Secretary Karen Ross.
subhead: Statewide coalition to accelerate adoption of climate-smart agricultural technologies and workforce development with $15 million from California Jobs First

title: Farm Robotics Challenge launches 2027 season with new divisions and Startup pathway
summary: The Alliance sponsors the 2027 Championship awards: more than $50,000 across three divisions.

title: Student innovators take center stage at Farm Robotics Challenge Awards on May 21
summary: Student teams present their farm robotics projects at the Farm Robotics Challenge Awards on May 21.

title: Lettuce, leafy greens focus of ag tech demonstrations on Salinas Valley farm Aug. 6
summary: A UC ANR Connect field day shows growers ag tech for lettuce and leafy greens on a Salinas Valley farm on Aug. 6.

title: Farmers invited to see latest vineyard ag tech in Mendocino County on June 30
summary: A UC ANR Connect field day at Hopland shows growers the latest vineyard technology on June 30.

title: CDFA, UC ANR and partners introduce California Agricultural Research and Innovation Roadmap
summary: CDFA, UC ANR and partners, including the Alliance, introduce a roadmap of 10-year research priorities and innovation priorities that the Alliance leads and updates every two years.

title: UC ANR receives 15.1 million to accelerate ag tech innovation
summary: The California Jobs First award funds the statewide network that became the California AgTech Alliance.
